MEDIA TECHNOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: MEDIA TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Fundamentals of Emerging Media Technology 1.2 Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 , the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Fundamentals of Emerging Media Technology 1.2 Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 .
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fundamentals of Emerging Media Technology 1.2 Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 .
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Fundamentals of Emerging Media Technology 1.2 Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 .
   D. Skip safety briefings for Fundamentals of Emerging Media Technology 1.2 Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 .

2. When learning Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Production.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Production.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Production.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Production.

3. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Input Cable Tester

4. When learning Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media.

5. When learning Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Med, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Med.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Med.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Med.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Med.

6. When learning Post- production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Post- production.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Post- production.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Post- production.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Post- production.

7. When learning Fundamentals of Media Technology, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Fundamentals of Media Technology.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fundamentals of Media Technology.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Fundamentals of Media Technology.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Fundamentals of Media Technology.

8. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. Keyboard
   C. Monitor
   D. CPU

9. When learning Live streaming Project, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Live streaming Project.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Live streaming Project.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Live streaming Project.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Live streaming Project.

10. When learning Digital Video Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Digital Video Production.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Digital Video Production.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Digital Video Production.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Digital Video Production.

11. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

12. When learning Photography: technology and techniques, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Photography: technology and techniques.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Photography: technology and techniques.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Photography: technology and techniques.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Photography: technology and techniques.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Fundamentals of Media Technology and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Pre- production and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Production and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
